note.text: Diseconomies of scale occur when expansion raises long-run average cost. Communication delays, coordination difficulties and weak monitoring can offset benefits of size. External diseconomies can arise as industry expansion creates congestion or pressure on scarce local resources. A temporary input-price shock is not automatically an internal diseconomy caused by a firm’s scale. Economies and diseconomies may operate together; the net cost pattern matters. Higher total spending alone does not establish diseconomies.

sections.heading: Your goal and connections
sections.text: By the end, you should be able to identify scale-related coordination costs and calculate a rise in long-run average cost. Builds on: economies of scale and average-cost comparisons. Leads to: evaluating growth instead of assuming bigger is always better.

sections.heading: Understand the economics
sections.text: Diseconomies of scale occur when expansion raises long-run average cost. Communication delays, coordination difficulties and weak monitoring can offset benefits of size. External diseconomies can arise as industry expansion creates congestion or pressure on scarce local resources. A temporary input-price shock is not automatically an internal diseconomy caused by a firm’s scale. Economies and diseconomies may operate together; the net cost pattern matters. Higher total spending alone does not establish diseconomies.

sections.heading: Follow the local case
sections.text: An invented processor expands across several departments. Instructions arrive late and incompatible schedules cause rework. In another case, industry-wide congestion delays many firms. The first mechanism arises within the firm, while the second concerns the local industry environment. Neither proves that every large organisation must fail.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Look for an explained link from scale to cost. Compare cost per unit under comparable plans, and distinguish internal from external causes. Then propose a response, such as clearer coordination, while recognising that a remedy also uses resources. Do not confuse long-run scale with diminishing returns to one variable input at fixed capacity.
